name: 仙侣情缘（早期测试版）
english_description: Part of the ES II engine family and the same lineage as its sibling archive "New Immortal Companions' Bond: Age of Mist" (xlqy_new2007) — an earlier, rougher development snapshot of the same codebase. According to notes included in the archive itself, it was originally a half-finished build the author used to test driver compatibility.
